title: Implement slugify
body: Lowercase, no accents; any non-alphanumeric character becomes a hyphen, with no repeated hyphens and none at the ends.

title: Roman numerals both ways
body: to_roman and from_roman for 1..3999, with subtractive notation.

title: Word wrapping
body: Greedy algorithm. A word longer than width goes alone on its line.

title: Word frequency
body: word_freq and top_words; ties are ordered alphabetically.

title: textkit CLI
body: Subcommands slug and wrap. An unknown subcommand returns 2 without raising an exception.

title: Text summary
body: summarize(text) returns three lines: word count, reading minutes and the 3 most frequent words. It is a big task: it can be split into subtasks with a sketch (textkit/summary_parts/ is reserved for the pieces).

title: Speed up count_primes
body: The current version tries divisors one by one. The patch that lowers the time of bench_primes.py wins.
